articles.title: Crypto wins regardless of Clarity Act vote, Coinbase's Armstrong says
articles.snippet: Coinbase CEO tells CNBC the crypto industry gets regulatory clarity whether or not the Senate passes the bill on Sept. 15.

articles.title: US sanctions Xinbi scam marketplace, restrains $52M in crypto
articles.snippet: The Justice Department seized Xinbi’s Telegram channels and two wallets as investigators pursued 47 additional wallets across its alleged laundering network.

articles.title: TRM Labs doubles valuation to $2B in Series C expansion
articles.snippet: The blockchain intelligence firm said its annual recurring revenue has quadrupled over the past three years as it expands its AI-powered investigations business.

articles.title: US Bank tests proprietary stablecoin in cross-border Stellar transaction
articles.snippet: The pilot moved USBDC between the bank’s North American and European entities on the public Stellar blockchain.

articles.title: This Guy Cloned Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and Zuckerberg Into AI Bots. They Immediately Started Fighting
articles.snippet: Kun Chen built chatbot versions of four AI CEOs on SpaceXAI's new Grok Bot templates, locked them in one chat, and told them to debate the AI race until they agreed on something.
